tweets.text:
Day 12/

We’ve made improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get. We achieved this by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and improved request routing that allows us to increase cache hits.
@maria_rcks Can’t argue with that, Let’s break the cycle.

Day 11/

We've landed a series of changes and more compute to very significantly decrease the occurrence of the disruptive "Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model". When it does happen, it should also eventually just continue by itself and not just block on it.

Let us know if you still see it out there in the wild and we'll take a look.
Landing within the next 2 hours

The reports of my reset button being lost are greatly exaggerated

Day 10/ Reset
Good plans are simple. I have one that should result in significantly more usage for everyone. Hope to get it done soon.
Mashed @poteto on the house.
What would you like with your side of reset? It's done. https://t.co/gpNaB6otgy

We're all proud of you @birdabo. Thank you for solving this one, hadn't thought about it

Day 6/ Reset

@rohit3a Folks. Why do you think we picked 300k for context length for Codex. 

We ran the numbers and it’s better. We can run it at 1M too but it would just cost more of the usage. Good defaults are important.

Day 5/

Composer predictions in the desktop app. Often leads to a double take with how on point they are. Included in the Pro plans without consuming usage. https://t.co/02dqoClrWn
Confirmed landed across all accounts. How are we doing so far? https://t.co/tzw7dNX4pN
Will be there by EOD PST.

Day 3/

The big one is GPT-6 in Chat, but today is also a little celebration day with a new high of 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work.

Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts. See you again tomorrow! https://t.co/mHSI0PbWfe
Also! Good evening!!
And we won't unship the improvements. You get to have your cake and eat it too. See you tomorrow for Day 3!

We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment.

Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
I accept your vote
Is this how the internet works 👀
Feels right, but such is the game

I do like giving resets

Roundup of Day 2/

2.1/ Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used. Also better for you.
2.2/ Simplified API for builders.
2.3/ Meeting notes integrated.
2.4/ Decisions API live for builders. Will use in the app to improve the experience.
No dodge, just three updates today
Will be even more blissful to manage both
Let’s call upon the @poteto
You can be part of the judge panel for the 28 days

We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...).

No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
